fieldValues.title: Membership and quorum
fieldValues.article_text: Members: Steward (convener and liaison), Builder and Reviewer, each running under its own SRS_ACTOR (agent:tpr-steward, agent:tpr-builder, agent:tpr-reviewer); the owner is the parent role. Quorum for a merge: the Builder plus a different Reviewer, as two distinct actors, with green gates. The group never self-reviews: a run never reviews a PR its own run built.
fieldValues.rationale: Keeps the review independent even though all actors share one GitHub identity (owner ruling D7, 2026-10-09).
fieldValues.amendment_rule: Owner only: an amendment needs a new owner-ratified decision.
fieldValues.protected_status: Agent testimony until the owner ratifies the charter decision.
